stream.input: 16-bit signed integer IQ; one sample per in_valid cycle; no backpressure
stream.latency: RX/TX calibration and router:1stage; target_complex_operator:2stages; fractional_delay_profile:8stages; basic programmable fractional_delay:1stage (arithmetic-only, not hardware selected for63tap)
stream.bubble: valid/qualification/numeric output aligned through module-specific pipeline; numeric/status outputs zero on output bubbles
stream.reset: synchronous active-high; clears output and FIR history
stream.invalid_table: valid input produces valid zero sample, calibration/model/coeff validity false, saturation false; downstream must reject precision/RF operation
stream.metadata: Caller pipelines task/table IDs alongside data and snapshots all parameters for a record. No CDC, loader, age check or ID storage inside arithmetic modules.
stream.edge_definition: For input sampled immediately before rising edge n: one-stagecal/router output updates afteredge n; two-stagetarget afteredge n+1; eight-stageprofile afteredge n+7. A downstream registered consumer samples on the next edge. Use this definition rather than silently summing nanoseconds.

arithmetic.coefficient_format: signed 18-bit two's complement, 16 fractional bits; range [-2, 2-2^-16]; unity=65536
arithmetic.rounding: nearest ties to even for both signs, then clamp [-32768,32767]
arithmetic.target: M*H/V followed by external phase_i+j*phase_q, full intermediate precision; only final round_sat shift32
arithmetic.target_internal: 34-bit input/coefficient products, 36-bit matrix sums, 54-bit phase products, 55-bit final sums
arithmetic.doppler_policy: External phasor applied exactly once. No oscillator/phase accumulation and no implicit one/two-way factor. Caller responsible for phase_id, timestamp and accepted task policy.
arithmetic.target_packing: in/out bits15:0 HI,31:16 HQ,47:32 VI,63:48 VQ; matrix ascending 18-bit fields HH.real, HH.imag, HV.real, HV.imag, VH.real, VH.imag, VV.real, VV.imag
arithmetic.target_pipeline: 2stages: full36bit matrix sum with captured external phase, followed by phase multiply and final quantization. Delay task metadata and phase policy accordingly.
arithmetic.target_actual_dsp_budget: 34DSP observed versus24planning allowance; +10DSP disclosed, full intermediate precision retained

calibration_table.storage_status: FORMAT_DEFINED; table RAM/CSR loader and lifecycle validation not implemented here
calibration_table.acceptance: Control validates envelope, channel/reference/binding and expiry, pins immutable generation through record, then asserts cal_valid; unbound/expired/mismatched entries remain invalid
calibration_table.scope: One executor instance per channel: RX read copy only; TX after source mux and DAC routing for all sources. Common integer delay and FIR group delay bookkeeping belong to replay scheduler, not this gain executor.

fractional_delay.packing: ascending 18-bit signed real coefficients h[0] through h[TAPS-1], each16 fractional bits
fractional_delay.equation: y[n]=round_sat(sum h[k]*x[n-k],16), separately I and Q; input-valid sample indexing
fractional_delay.history: advances on in_valid even if coeff_valid=0; bubbles pause; clear discards current sample and zeroes history/output; clear before a new record/profile
fractional_delay.table_update: caller snapshots coefficient vector; no atomic loader inside FIR; changing coefficients without clear intentionally filters existing history with new taps
fractional_delay.demonstration_fraction_profile: for mu_q16 in0..65535: h0=65536-mu_q16,h1=mu_q16,remaining0; true linear fractional interpolation, not approved wideband profile
fractional_delay.demonstration_band_limit: At fractional delay0.5 and50MHz/125MSps, two-tap interpolation magnitude=cos(0.4*pi)=0.3090, approx -10.20dB. Fails any precision flatness claim; no bandwidth acceptance inferred.
unresolved: full system scheduler integration and board precision

profile_wrapper.latency: 8registered stages: product, six balanced binary sum levels, final quantizer; no additional wrapper data register
profile_wrapper.commit: accept iff profile_commit && safe_boundary && !in_valid && shadow_version==table_version; otherwise reject pulse; no deferred pending request
profile_wrapper.freeze: latch whole1134bit coefficient vector, phase and32bit version on accepted commit; clear old FIR history same edge; values remain immutable until next accepted boundary
profile_wrapper.boundary: caller guarantees previous record,62validzero tail samples and8stage output pipeline are drained; input bubble alone is not safe_boundary
profile_wrapper.version: generated32bit SHA256 prefix; full SHA256 retained in coefficient contract; source/memory file must be hash checked by build, 32bit tag is identity not integrity proof
profile_wrapper.validity: before accepted profile commit, coeff-valid false and numeric output zero; this profile-validity is not RF calibration-validity
profile_wrapper.group_delay: 31+phase/256 samples =248ns+phase*0.03125ns at125MS/s;8processing register stages separate;62validzero tail samples then pipeline drain
profile_wrapper.memory: 256x1134bit generated embedded constantROM; no COEFF_FILE parameter or runtime file access; golden.mem retained for review/hash
